title: Sell Mineral Rights in Muncy, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Muncy, PA | Lycoming County
metaDescription: Muncy, PA sits along the Susquehanna in Lycoming County's dry-gas Marcellus core. We buy mineral and royalty rights directly, honest talk on deductions.
heroLead: Muncy is one of the older river towns along the Susquehanna in Lycoming County, and a lot of the farmland around it has been in the same families since long before anyone drilled a Marcellus well here.
intro: The valley around Muncy has good soil, which is why it stayed farmland for so long, and why so many of the mineral interests here trace back to working farms rather than industrial land. When Marcellus leasing arrived, a lot of those farms got pooled into horizontal units that reach well beyond any single family's original acreage.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Muncy directly. We do the title research through the county records ourselves, and we'll explain every part of what we find before discussing a number.

sections.heading: Farm Valley, Dry-Gas Rock
paragraphs: Lycoming County sits in the dry-gas portion of the Marcellus fairway, and Muncy Township has seen sustained operator interest for over a decade. Without liquids to process, your royalty statement here is generally simpler to read than a wet-gas one, though gathering and compression fees are still standard deductions.
Wells around Muncy have generally followed the typical decline curve, strong initial production tapering into a longer, steadier tail, and we look at that full arc when reviewing an interest here.

sections.heading: Tracing a Family Farm's Mineral History
paragraphs: We research your chain of title through the Lycoming County Recorder of Deeds in Williamsport, which for older Muncy-area farms sometimes means working through inheritance records spanning several generations before reaching your name.
If the paperwork feels incomplete on your end, that's common with family land held this long, and we can usually reconstruct it through the recorder's own files.

sections.heading: Understanding Your Royalty Statement
paragraphs: We'll walk through your division order and royalty history with you so you understand your decimal interest and what's being deducted, in plain terms, before we ever discuss a purchase price.

faqs.question: My family's farm near Muncy has been in the family for generations. Does that complicate a sale?
faqs.answer: It can mean more title research to trace inheritance, but it doesn't prevent a sale. We handle that research as part of our review.

faqs.question: Is dry gas easier to evaluate than wet gas?
faqs.answer: Statements are generally more straightforward without liquids-processing line items, but value still depends on your specific decimal interest and production history.

faqs.question: What if my well's production has slowed down significantly?
faqs.answer: A declining well can still hold real value, particularly with a solid production history. We'll give you an honest read based on the actual numbers.
